bridgeToNext.hi: Ab yahi tenths aur hundredths units badalne mein kaam aayenge: cm se metre, mm se cm, aur paise se rupaye.
bridgeToNext.en: Next, these same tenths and hundredths help us change units: cm to metres, mm to cm, and paise to rupees.

simpler.hi: Ab tenths aur hundredths se units badalna seekhenge, jaise cm se metre. Board par ek number line zoom ki hui hai.
simpler.en: Now we use tenths and hundredths to change units, like cm to metres. On the board a number line is zoomed in.

hook.convey: 100 cm = 1 m and 100 paise = ₹1 → cm and paise sit in the hundredths place; 10 mm = 1 cm → mm sit in the tenths place of a cm; a car's length on a parking board, a price on a kitchen bill

use.hi: Ek car 4 m 35 cm lambi hai. Parking board par yahi lambai metre mein likhi jaati hai, kyunki 35 cm metre ke 35 hundredths hain.
use.en: A car is 4 m 35 cm long. On a parking board the same length is written in metres, because 35 cm is 35 hundredths of a metre.

use.hi: Kitchen ke saaman ka bill dekho: ₹1 mein 100 paise hote hain, isliye paise rupaye ke baad point ke aage do jagah mein likhe jaate hain.
use.en: Look at a bill for kitchen things: ₹1 has 100 paise, so paise are written in the two places after the point, following the rupees.

explain.convey: a height of 1 m 25 cm: 25 cm = 25 hundredths of a metre → 1.25 m on the zoomed line; adding cm adds hundredths → the child adds 5 cm and gets 1.3 m (not 1.75 m)

point.hi: Ek bachche ki oonchai 1 m 25 cm hai. 100 cm = 1 m, toh 25 cm metre ke 25 hundredths hain. Isliye 1 m 25 cm = 1.25 m, jo is line par 1 aur 2 ke beech hai.
point.en: A child's height is 1 m 25 cm. 100 cm = 1 m, so 25 cm is 25 hundredths of a metre. So 1 m 25 cm = 1.25 m, which is between 1 and 2 on this line.

prompt.hi: Is 1.25 m wali oonchai mein 5 cm aur jodo, toh nayi oonchai kitne metre hogi?
prompt.en: Add 5 cm to this height of 1.25 m. How many metres is the new height?

simpler.hi: 100 cm = 1 m, toh 25 cm metre ke 25 hundredths hain. Isliye 1 m 25 cm = 1.25 m.
simpler.en: 100 cm = 1 m, so 25 cm is 25 hundredths of a metre. So 1 m 25 cm = 1.25 m.

explain.convey: 80 cm = 80 hundredths = 0.80 m, but 8 cm = 8 hundredths = 0.08 m: with fewer than 10 cm the tenths place holds 0 → the child adds 1 cm to 8 cm and writes 0.09 m (not 0.9 m)

point.hi: 80 cm metre ke 80 hundredths hain, yaani 0.80 m. Par 8 cm sirf 8 hundredths hain, isliye tenths ki jagah 0 aata hai aur 8 cm = 0.08 m.
point.en: 80 cm is 80 hundredths of a metre, that is 0.80 m. But 8 cm is only 8 hundredths, so the tenths place gets 0 and 8 cm = 0.08 m.

prompt.hi: Is 8 cm wale tukde mein 1 cm aur jodo, toh woh kitne metre ka hoga?
prompt.en: Add 1 cm to this 8 cm piece. How many metres long will it be?

why.hi: 8 cm = 0.08 m, aur 8 + 1 = 9 cm, jo metre ke 9 hundredths hain, yaani 0.09 m
why.en: 8 cm = 0.08 m, and 8 + 1 = 9 cm, which is 9 hundredths of a metre, so 0.09 m

simpler.hi: 80 cm metre ke 80 hundredths hain, yaani 0.80 m. Par 8 cm sirf 8 hundredths hain, isliye tenths ki jagah 0 aata hai: 0.08 m.
simpler.en: 80 cm is 80 hundredths of a metre, 0.80 m. But 8 cm is only 8 hundredths, so the tenths place gets 0: 0.08 m.

explain.convey: 1 cm = 10 equal mm → 1 mm = 1/10 cm = 0.1 cm: mm go in the tenths place of a cm, not the hundredths → the child writes 23 mm in cm

point.hi: 1 cm mein 10 barabar mm hote hain. Isliye 1 mm = 1/10 cm = 0.1 cm. Yahan mm, cm ka tenth hai, hundredth nahi.
point.en: 1 cm has 10 equal mm. So 1 mm = 1/10 cm = 0.1 cm. Here a mm is a tenth of a cm, not a hundredth.

prompt.hi: Ek keeda 23 mm lamba hai. Woh kitne cm ka hai?
prompt.en: An insect is 23 mm long. How many cm is it?

why.hi: 1 mm = 0.1 cm aur 10 mm = 1 cm, toh 23 mm = 2.3 cm hota hai
why.en: 1 mm = 0.1 cm and 10 mm = 1 cm, so 23 mm makes 2.3 cm

simpler.hi: 1 cm mein 10 barabar mm hote hain. Isliye ek mm, ek cm ka dasva hissa hai: 0.1 cm.
simpler.en: 1 cm has 10 equal mm. So one mm is a tenth of a cm: 0.1 cm.

explain.convey: ₹1 = 100 paise → 1 paisa = 1/100 rupee = ₹0.01: paise take the two places after the point, so a single-digit paise amount needs a 0 in the tenths place → the child writes ₹6 and 4 paise as ₹6.04 (not ₹6.4)

point.hi: ₹1 mein 100 paise hote hain, toh 1 paisa = 1/100 rupaya = ₹0.01. Isliye paise hamesha point ke baad ki do jagah lete hain.
point.en: ₹1 has 100 paise, so 1 paisa = 1/100 rupee = ₹0.01. That is why paise always take the two places after the point.

prompt.hi: ₹6 aur 4 paise ko rupaye mein decimal se likho.
prompt.en: Write ₹6 and 4 paise in rupees as a decimal.

why.hi: ₹1 mein 100 paise hote hain, toh 1 paisa ₹0.01 aur 4 paise ₹0.04 hain: ₹6.04
why.en: ₹1 has 100 paise, so 1 paisa is ₹0.01 and 4 paise are ₹0.04: ₹6.04

simpler.hi: ₹1 mein 100 paise hote hain, toh 1 paisa = ₹0.01. Paise hamesha point ke baad do jagah lete hain.
simpler.en: ₹1 has 100 paise, so 1 paisa = ₹0.01. Paise always take two places after the point.

problem.hi: Ek almaari 2 m 7 cm oonchi hai, aur 1 m mein 100 cm hote hain. Uski oonchai sirf metre mein, decimal se likho.
problem.en: A cupboard is 2 m 7 cm tall, and 1 m has 100 cm. Write its height in metres only, as a decimal.

simpler.hi: 1 m mein 100 cm hote hain, toh 7 cm ek metre ke 100 hisson mein se 7 hisse hai. Ise decimal mein do jagah tak likhna hai.
simpler.en: 1 m has 100 cm, so 7 cm is 7 of the 100 parts of a metre. Write it as a decimal with two places.

givens.en: the cupboard is 2 m 7 cm tall

find.en: the height in metres, as a decimal

why.hi: 100 barabar cm milkar 1 metre banate hain
why.en: 100 equal cm make 1 metre

simpler.hi: 100 barabar cm milkar 1 metre banate hain. Isliye 1 cm = 1/100 m = 0.01 m.
simpler.en: 100 equal cm make 1 metre. So 1 cm = 1/100 m = 0.01 m.

why.hi: har cm metre ka ek hundredth hai
why.en: each cm is one hundredth of a metre

simpler.hi: Har cm metre ka ek hundredth hai. Toh 7 cm = 7/100 m = 0.07 m.
simpler.en: Each cm is one hundredth of a metre. So 7 cm = 7/100 m = 0.07 m.

why.hi: 7 cm mein ek bhi poora tenth yaani 10 cm nahi hai
why.en: 7 cm does not hold even one whole tenth, that is 10 cm

simpler.hi: 7 cm mein ek poora tenth bhi nahi banta. Isliye tenths ki jagah 0 aata hai.
simpler.en: 7 cm does not make even one whole tenth. So the tenths place gets 0.

prompt.hi: Ab 2 m aur 0.07 m ko saath likho. Almaari kitne metre oonchi hai?
prompt.en: Now put 2 m and 0.07 m together. How many metres tall is the cupboard?

simpler.hi: Poore 2 m point se pehle likho. Phir point ke baad 0.07 wale digits likho.
simpler.en: Write the 2 whole m before the point. Then write the digits of 0.07 after the point.

why.hi: almaari 2 m 7 cm hai, aur 7 cm = 7/100 m = 0.07 m, toh 2 + 0.07 = 2.07 m

answer.hi: almaari 2 m 7 cm yaani 2.07 m oonchi hai
answer.en: the cupboard is 2 m 7 cm, that is 2.07 m, tall

why.hi: 7 cm sirf 7 hundredths metre hai, isliye 7 point ke baad doosri jagah par aata hai, tenths ki jagah 0
why.en: 7 cm is only 7 hundredths of a metre, so 7 goes second after the point and the tenths place is 0

prompt.hi: Ek pauda ek hafte mein 9 cm bada hua. Yeh badhat kitne metre hai?
prompt.en: A plant grew 9 cm in a week. How many metres is this growth?

why.hi: badhat 9 cm hai, aur 1 m = 100 cm, toh 9 cm metre ke 9 hundredths hain: 0.09 m
why.en: the growth is 9 cm, and 1 m = 100 cm, so 9 cm is 9 hundredths of a metre: 0.09 m

simpler.hi: 9 cm metre ke sirf 9 hundredths hain. Socho, tenths ki jagah par kya aayega.
simpler.en: 9 cm is only 9 hundredths of a metre. Think what goes in the tenths place.

prompt.hi: Ek pen ₹8 aur 3 paise ka hai. Uska daam rupaye mein decimal se likho.
prompt.en: A pen costs ₹8 and 3 paise. Write its price in rupees as a decimal.

why.hi: pen ₹8 aur 3 paise ka hai, ₹1 = 100 paise, toh 3 paise = ₹0.03, aur ₹8.03 banta hai
why.en: the pen is ₹8 and 3 paise, ₹1 = 100 paise, so 3 paise = ₹0.03, and it makes ₹8.03

simpler.hi: 3 paise rupaye ke 3 hundredths hain. Paise point ke baad do jagah lete hain.
simpler.en: 3 paise is 3 hundredths of a rupee. Paise take two places after the point.

prompt.hi: Sports day par Neha ki chhalaang 2 m 6 cm thi aur Kiran ki 2.6 m. Dono chhalaangon mein kitne cm ka farak hai?
prompt.en: On sports day Neha's jump was 2 m 6 cm and Kiran's was 2.6 m. How many cm apart are the two jumps?

why.hi: Kiran ki 2.6 m = 2 m 60 cm aur Neha ki 2 m 6 cm, toh 60 − 6 = 54
why.en: Kiran's 2.6 m = 2 m 60 cm and Neha's is 2 m 6 cm, so 60 − 6 = 54

simpler.hi: Kiran ki 2.6 m ko m aur cm mein badlo. Phir dono chhalaangon ke cm milao.
simpler.en: Change Kiran's 2.6 m into m and cm. Then compare the cm of the two jumps.

ladder.why: first straight use: a height of 1 m 45 cm → 1.45 m
₹3 and 5 paise → ₹3.05, the 0 that holds the tenths place
error-spot: 8 cm written as 0.8 m → it is 0.08 m, and 0.8 m would be 80 cm
far transfer: two sports-day jumps, 3 m 8 cm against 3.8 m → who jumped further, by 72 cm

remediation.move: metre strip marked in cm: 1 m is 100 cm, not 10, so 5 cm is 5 of 100 parts = 0.05 m; 0.5 m is 50 cm, half the strip

say.hi: 1 metre mein 100 cm hote hain, 10 nahi. Isliye 5 cm = 0.05 m hai, aur 0.5 m toh 50 cm hota hai.
say.en: 1 metre has 100 cm, not 10. So 5 cm = 0.05 m, and 0.5 m is 50 cm.

simpler.hi: 1 metre mein 100 cm hote hain. Isliye 5 cm = 0.05 m, aur 0.5 m = 50 cm.
simpler.en: 1 metre has 100 cm. So 5 cm = 0.05 m, and 0.5 m = 50 cm.

prompt.hi: Ek rubber 4 cm lamba hai. Yeh kitne metre hai?
prompt.en: An eraser is 4 cm long. How many metres is that?

why.hi: rubber 4 cm hai aur 1 m = 100 cm, toh 4 cm metre ke 4 hundredths hain: 0.04 m
why.en: the eraser is 4 cm and 1 m = 100 cm, so 4 cm is 4 hundredths of a metre: 0.04 m

simpler.hi: 4 cm metre ke 4 hundredths hain. Tenths ki jagah ka dhyaan rakho.
simpler.en: 4 cm is 4 hundredths of a metre. Mind the tenths place.

remediation.move: paise fill two places after the point: 5 paise = ₹0.05, so ₹3 and 5 paise = ₹3.05; ₹3.5 would be ₹3 and 50 paise

say.hi: Paise ko rupaye mein likhne par point ke baad do jagah bharti hain. 5 paise = ₹0.05, isliye ₹3 aur 5 paise = ₹3.05, aur ₹3.5 toh ₹3 aur 50 paise hai.
say.en: When you write paise in rupees, two places after the point fill up. 5 paise = ₹0.05, so ₹3 and 5 paise = ₹3.05, and ₹3.5 is ₹3 and 50 paise.

simpler.hi: Paise point ke baad do jagah lete hain. ₹3 aur 5 paise = ₹3.05, aur ₹3.5 = ₹3 aur 50 paise.
simpler.en: Paise take two places after the point. ₹3 and 5 paise = ₹3.05, while ₹3.5 = ₹3 and 50 paise.

prompt.hi: ₹5 aur 7 paise ko rupaye mein decimal se likho.
prompt.en: Write ₹5 and 7 paise in rupees as a decimal.

why.hi: ₹1 = 100 paise, toh 7 paise rupaye ke 7 hundredths hain, yaani ₹0.07, aur ₹5 + ₹0.07 = ₹5.07
why.en: ₹1 = 100 paise, so 7 paise is 7 hundredths of a rupee, ₹0.07, and ₹5 + ₹0.07 = ₹5.07

simpler.hi: 7 paise rupaye ke 7 hundredths hain. Paise point ke baad do jagah lete hain.
simpler.en: 7 paise is 7 hundredths of a rupee. Paise take two places after the point.
